note: Recorded with tools/ui/record-baseline.js (it runs tools/ui/measure-layout.js in a fresh same-origin iframe per width and tab, a unique ?v= per load, --target: 48px forced, i.e. a coarse pointer) at 375, 768, 1100 and 1440 px for the three tabs (the tab in the URL hash is the one measured). Rects are [x, y, w, h] in document coordinates; null = element hidden or absent. Per tab: start (no layer), shape_switch, square_sin_field (the net chapter: netz_row = the Netz tab with the square, square_sin_field = Sinus + the Field default + one strength step, more_netz_open = the Netz Mehr overlay open, found = which controls the script found and the state it reached), layer_timeline (two layers, two keyframes). This file does not replace baseline-phase1.json (the original phase-1 baseline, commit 7ae041c0, Form tab only, the old toolbar): that one stays as the 'before' of the whole UI rework; compare a later state with THIS file. Tooling, not part of the test suite (it needs a browser).
